principle: Explicit project adoption; no automatic overwrite

codes.usage: Read before creating or changing a machine.

codes.meaning: Build or update a project tracker
codes.usage: Scope, tasks, evidence, decisions, release and recovery. Tracker updates alone do not authorize unrelated site changes.
Use Benji’s source voice and the book’s selected E or F mode. No automatic canon changes.
Use natural English with Benji’s scene logic and approved craft rules. English 2 is a retired style label.
Open the grey rectangle for actual saved modification, author, method, version and separate release.
Present analysis and proposed decisions. Do not implement the proposal until authorized.
Apply only to the authorized project. Verify live source and required recovery evidence before claiming a lock.
Approve the clearly identified proposal or scope. It does not approve unrelated changes.
Publish the identified approved result, preserving existing audience and scope.
Prepare the identified handoff; sending requires an available authorized destination. Never claim it was sent when only prepared.
